stories.title: Yemen's civil war returns and overwhelms hospitals
stories.summary: Renewed fighting has swamped Yemen's hospitals, with children sharing emergency room beds and some pregnant women turned away as facilities focus on the wounded. The breakdown in care deepens the humanitarian crisis in the Arab world's poorest country.

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV opens four-day visit to France
stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV began a four-day state visit to France on Friday, using it to renew appeals for peace and for global rules on AI. Up to a million people are expected to attend events in Paris, Lourdes and Metz — the first papal state visit in 18 years.

stories.title: Trump hosts Xi for White House state dinner
stories.summary: President Trump welcomed China's Xi Jinping to a White House state dinner Thursday evening after a day of talks covering trade, global conflicts and AI. The summit comes as the U.S. presses China over concerns its firms are copying American AI technology.

stories.title: MAGA base recoils as Trump goes all-in on AI
stories.summary: Financial Times reporting describes friction between President Trump's full embrace of artificial intelligence and parts of his MAGA base wary of the technology. The tension is shaping the politics of both AI policy and the administration's outreach.

stories.title: The cheap new AI model taking aim at OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.summary: Analysts are tracking a low-cost AI model positioning itself against pricier offerings from OpenAI and Anthropic, part of a broader price war in the sector. Cheaper frontier-grade models would pressure margins and reshape enterprise adoption.

stories.title: ASML sold 'absolutely nothing' in Europe in 2026
stories.summary: Chip-tool maker ASML says it sold no machines in Europe in the first half of 2026 because no continental fabs are being built, as its regional revenue share fell to 0%. The company is pressing EU authorities to create domestic chip demand to keep Europe competitive.

stories.title: Trump allies cast Anthropic CEO Amodei as AI 'doomerism' face ahead of IPO
stories.summary: Axios reports a memo circulating in the White House this week paints Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei as the face of AI 'doomerism' ahead of the company's record IPO. The political pressure marks a new front in the clash over AI safety and regulation.

stories.title: Browns vs. Panthers: Storylines, scouting report and picks for Week 3
stories.summary: Cleveland.com's Orange and Brown Talk previews the Browns' home opener against the Carolina Panthers on Sept. 27, breaking down matchups and picks for the Week 3 game. The Browns return to Huntington Bank Field after a 23-19 win in Tampa.

stories.title: Myles Garrett replacement Jared Verse not worried about slow start
stories.summary: Edge rusher Jared Verse, acquired from the Rams to replace Myles Garrett, is still without a sack this season but he and the coaching staff say they aren't concerned. The pass rush pressure is a key storyline as Cleveland opens its home schedule.

stories.title: Illinois coach Bret Bielema previews the Buckeyes
stories.summary: Illinois coach Bret Bielema discussed facing No. 7 Ohio State as the Illini open Big Ten play at the Horseshoe on Saturday, reminiscing about OSU rivalries in the process. It's Ohio State's first conference game of 2026.

stories.title: Verstappen beats Russell and Hamilton in Azerbaijan FP3
stories.summary: Max Verstappen topped final practice for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, edging Mercedes' George Russell and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton. It sets up a tight qualifying battle at the Baku street circuit.

stories.title: Beganovic takes second consecutive win in F2 Baku Sprint Race
stories.summary: Dino Beganovic won the Formula 2 Baku Sprint Race, his second straight victory, with a strong drive for DAMS Lucas Oil. The win extends his momentum ahead of the Azerbaijan feature race this weekend.

stories.title: Hamilton: Others 'just took another step' in Baku practice
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton said rivals 'just took another step' after a strong Ferrari showing in Azerbaijan practice, tempering expectations despite a competitive Friday. The comments frame Ferrari's pace question heading into qualifying.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov: Arena free weekend goes live
stories.summary: Battlestate Games made Escape from Tarkov: Arena free to play through Sept. 27 to celebrate Season 3, with up to 20% discounts and Twitch Drop campaigns running all weekend. It's a chance to try the revamped BlastGang mode and new progression features.

stories.title: 1 dead after north Columbus hotel shooting
stories.summary: Police are investigating a shooting at a hotel in north Columbus that left one person dead, NBC4 reported Friday morning. Details on a suspect or motive have not yet been released.

stories.title: New, expanded Columbus airport flights for spring break
stories.summary: Columbus travelers will get new and expanded nonstop flight options ahead of spring break, including a new Southwest route. The additions give John Glenn International more direct connections for the travel season.
